entities.name: Raymond F. Burghardt

entities.summary: Raymond Burghardt is an American diplomat who served as the United States Ambassador to Vietnam from 2002 to 2004, Director (1999-2001) as well as Chairman of American Institute in Taiwan from 2006 to 2016.
